attributions.surface_quote: Expiration, cross-breathing, inspiration, Vasat, hail, reverence!

canonical_statement: The structure of the phenomenal world is maintained by a system of archetypal correspondences where specific entities or forces govern their respective domains.

attributions.surface_quote: By fire he surmounted fervour, by speech holy power... by the sun the sky.

canonical_statement: Meditation and the act of focusing the mind are foundational ritual acts that connect the practitioner to the divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: Hail! (To) meditation (I offer). To that meditated upon hail!

canonical_statement: The divine is manifested through a multiplicity of distinct functional aspects and personified powers.

attributions.surface_quote: To Prajapati hail! To Ka hail! To Who hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To the teeth hail! To the jaws hail! ... To all hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To the glossy and variegated one hail! ... To form hail! To all hail!

canonical_statement: The divine or sacred essence is immanent in all forms, states, and manifestations of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: To the one of like form hail! To all hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To the plants hail! To the roots hail! To all hail!

attributions.surface_quote: He saw this rite... and became their Purohita.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jyotis is this earth, the Go the atmosphere, and the Ayus yonder sky.

attributions.surface_quote: The year is the world of heaven.

attributions.surface_quote: The Gayatri is of twenty-four syllables; the Gayatri is splendour.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who knowing thus perform... placing the Viraj in themselves, win food.

attributions.surface_quote: verily by them do they proceed to the world of heaven.

attributions.surface_quote: for the world of heaven for man is prosperity.

attributions.surface_quote: Those, who knowing thus perform the rite, mount openly upon the deities.

attributions.surface_quote: The twelve-day rite is speech; they perform speech perfectly.

attributions.surface_quote: They saw this rite... grasped it, and sacrificed with it. Then indeed did they discern.

attributions.surface_quote: There are Sadahas; six are the seasons; verily in the seasons they find support.

attributions.surface_quote: They obtain sovereignty who knowing thus perform the rite.

attributions.surface_quote: Both from the deficient, indeed, and from the redundant Prajapati was propagated.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jyotistoma is the world of heaven... verily by it they go to the world of heaven.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jyotistoma is the beginning of the Stomas; verily they commence the Stomas from the beginning.

attributions.surface_quote: The Viraj is strength.

attributions.surface_quote: by it they find support in this world... atmosphere... yonder world.

attributions.surface_quote: Man is of twelve parts... Therefore (the days) follow man.

attributions.surface_quote: The year is not fixed... It is greater than a support.

attributions.surface_quote: they mount the wheel of the gods, for safety.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art an overlord; make me an overlord; may I be overlord of creatures.

canonical_statement: Divine greatness transcends the spatial dimensions of the earth and the regions.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou hast surpassed in might... The regions comprehend not thy greatness.

canonical_statement: The sky is the primordial conceptual origin of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The sky was the first conception.

attributions.surface_quote: The moon is born again.

canonical_statement: The earth functions as the primary container or enveloper of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Earth is the great enveloper.

canonical_statement: The sacrificial act serves as the central point or navel of the world.

attributions.surface_quote: They call the sacrifice the navel of the world.

canonical_statement: Brahman constitutes the ultimate and highest domain of speech.

attributions.surface_quote: They call the Brahman the highest realm of speech.

canonical_statement: The divine or cosmic order manifests form out of the formless.

attributions.surface_quote: Making a banner for that which hath none, Form for the formless

attributions.surface_quote: To expiration hail! To cross-breathing hail! To inspiration hail!

canonical_statement: All states of being, whether bound or unbound, are encompassed within the totality of the sacred.

attributions.surface_quote: To the bound hail! To the unbound hail!

canonical_statement: The elements of nature, such as water, possess inherent healing and life-sustaining metaphysical properties.

attributions.surface_quote: Ye waters are healing; Further us to strength

attributions.surface_quote: The cows performed that Sattra... with the desire, 'May horns be born to us.'

attributions.surface_quote: The year is the cows' Sattra.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who knowing thus perform the year (sacrifice) are prosperous.

canonical_statement: Time is a cyclical ocean that must be traversed to reach transcendence.

attributions.surface_quote: The ocean is the year. Those who perform the year are swimming on the ocean.

canonical_statement: Ritual structure mirrors the fundamental duality of the universe, such as earth and sky.

attributions.surface_quote: The former Atiratra is this earth, the latter is yonder sky.

canonical_statement: Metrical patterns and sacred sounds function as the metaphysical path to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The path that leads to the gods is the metres.

attributions.surface_quote: The verses are the world of man; verily they keep mounting one world of gods.

attributions.surface_quote: The cows performed that Sattra... desiring to obtain horns. For ten months they performed it.

canonical_statement: The efficacy of a ritual is contingent upon the practitioner's conscious knowledge of its structure and purpose.

attributions.surface_quote: He who ceases after ten months is prosperous, and he who ceases after twelve also, if he knows thus.

canonical_statement: The temporal cycle of the year represents an infinite, shoreless expanse of potentiality.

attributions.surface_quote: It is an ocean without a near or a further shore that they enter upon.

attributions.surface_quote: If they employ the Brhat and the Rathantara Samans, it would be as if they were to provide a boat.

attributions.surface_quote: The Rcs are the world of men... the Saman is the world of the gods.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed in the present can retroactively atone for errors committed in the past.

attributions.surface_quote: whatever is done wrongly in the earlier days, this serves to atone for it.

attributions.surface_quote: the sacrificers create offspring.

attributions.surface_quote: the metres descend from the Jagati... the younger descends before an elder.

attributions.surface_quote: He who does it first wins the speech, the gods, and the metres.

attributions.surface_quote: If they did not leave out a day, then the year would fall asunder.

attributions.surface_quote: they place breath in the year, and the performers of the Sattra breathe along it.

attributions.surface_quote: Prajapati is all the gods.

canonical_statement: Ritual action establishes a sympathetic resonance between human offerings and the specific domains of divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: verily they win the deities who share in the pressing from their several places.

attributions.surface_quote: on eight potsherds at the early pressing, on eleven at midday, twelve at third.

attributions.surface_quote: verily they go winning the world of heaven by the holy power

attributions.surface_quote: the world of heaven is as it were opposite from hence

attributions.surface_quote: verily they come, gazing on this world by repeating the verse

attributions.surface_quote: They won them again by the Kroça, and that is why the Kroça has the name.

attributions.surface_quote: Nine are the breaths in man; verily he places breaths in the sacrificers.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed in specific postures or locations grant access to distinct ontological realms, such as those of gods or men.

attributions.surface_quote: Five (verses) standing; verily they win the world of the gods; five sitting; verily they win the world of men.

attributions.surface_quote: The Viraj is of ten syllables, the Viraj is food; verily they win food.

canonical_statement: The vital breath functions as the unifying principle that sustains and protects the integrity of the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: Therefore one breath protects all the limbs.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed in the physical world serve as a structural bridge to access higher celestial realms.

attributions.surface_quote: the sacrificers make thus a bridge to mount, for the gaining of the world of heaven.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of multiple hierarchical planes of existence that provide support for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: So many indeed are the worlds, and in them in order they find support.

attributions.surface_quote: By means of the Arkya Prajapati created offspring... by means of the Ilamda he took away.

attributions.surface_quote: The lute has a hundred strings. Man is of a hundred years of age.

attributions.surface_quote: The voice of the drum is the highest form of speech; verily they conquer the earth.

attributions.surface_quote: One reviles, another extols. He who reviles purifies them.

attributions.surface_quote: They pierce the hide; verily they remove the sin of the sacrificers.

attributions.surface_quote: To earth hail! To the atmosphere hail! ... To all hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To that which will stream together... to that which hath streamed together.

attributions.surface_quote: To the toothed hail! To the toothless hail! ... To all hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To that which hath eyes hail! To the eyeless hail!

attributions.surface_quote: To that which hath blood hail! To the bloodless hail!

canonical_statement: Ritual action serves as a mechanism to align individual intent with cosmic forces for the purpose of manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: Let Visnu yoke thee, for the prosperity of this sacrifice

attributions.surface_quote: To Agni, of the Gayatri metre, the Trivrt Stoma, the spring season, offering is made.

attributions.surface_quote: he appeases it with its own portion, and the cruel fire does not spring up

attributions.surface_quote: Nine are the breaths in man, and the navel is the tenth

attributions.surface_quote: As Indra among the gods, as Manu among men, becomes he who knowing thus sacrifices

attributions.surface_quote: Whose shadow is immortality, whose shadow is death

attributions.surface_quote: Of thee the sky is the greatness, the Naksatras the form, the sun the splendour

attributions.surface_quote: The steed hath come to the earth... the atmosphere... the sky.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art the eye; place the eye in me. Thou art life; place life in me.

attributions.surface_quote: May the seasons in due order, and the year auspicious.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured through the harmonious integration of divine principles with their corresponding material or social domains.

attributions.surface_quote: As Agni with the earth made harmony, so for me may favourable harmonies be made.

attributions.surface_quote: To Agni, saviour from distress... to Mitra and Varuna, saviours from sin.

attributions.surface_quote: Reverence to Agni... maker of room; grant room to this thy sacrificer.

attributions.surface_quote: The head of the sacrificial horse is the dawn, the eye the sun.

attributions.surface_quote: When it chews, there is lightning; when it moves about, there is thundering.

canonical_statement: The origin and essential nature of the cosmic entity is the primordial sea.

attributions.surface_quote: The birthplace of the horse, indeed, is the sea, its kindred is the sea.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the symbolic structure of the universe grants the knower ontological power.

attributions.surface_quote: He who knows the head of the sacrificial horse becomes possessed of a head.
